en.summary: Compare official versions before a theme upgrade
details: Use native Git through base/git to compare versions and check upgrade changes.
<old>/<new>: tags or commit SHAs; <path>: a file or directory in the official repository.
Prepare the official checkout (PowerShell):
$banyanRef = "$env:TEMP/swaw/banyan/upgrade/official"                   #Official checkout directory
swban base/git clone https://github.com/SwawHQ/banyan.git "$banyanRef"  #Clone the official repository once
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" fetch origin --tags                      #Update branches and tags of an existing copy
Select versions:
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" tag -l "v*" --sort=-version:refname          #List official versions
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" rev-parse "<old>^{commit}" "<new>^{commit}"  #Resolve both commits
Inspect changes:
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" diff --name-status <old> <new>  #List changed files
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" log --oneline <old>..<new>      #List added commits
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" diff <old> <new> -- <path>      #Read file or directory changes
Tags can include prereleases. Read content/articles/changelog/ at the target version.
Update the theme and Skill, then review affected site files; see references/install.md: Change the version.

zh.summary: 比对官方版本，检查主题升级变动
details: 通过 base/git 使用原生 Git 比对版本，辅助主题升级。
<old>/<new>：标签或提交 SHA；<path>：官方仓库内的文件或目录。
准备官方副本（PowerShell）：
$banyanRef = "$env:TEMP/swaw/banyan/upgrade/official"                   #官方副本目录
swban base/git clone https://github.com/SwawHQ/banyan.git "$banyanRef"  #首次获取官方仓库
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" fetch origin --tags                      #已有副本时更新分支和标签
选择版本：
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" tag -l "v*" --sort=-version:refname          #查看官方版本
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" rev-parse "<old>^{commit}" "<new>^{commit}"  #确认两个版本的提交
检查变动：
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" diff --name-status <old> <new>  #列出变动文件
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" log --oneline <old>..<new>      #列出新增提交
swban base/git -C "$banyanRef" diff <old> <new> -- <path>      #查看文件或目录差异
标签可能包含预发布版。版本说明见目标版本的 content/articles/changelog/。
更新主题与 Skill，再检查受影响的站点文件；步骤见 references/install.md 的 Change the version。
